scenarios.name: Scenario A: Single Supplier (Coorg Heritage Coffee Estate)
scenarios.strategy: Full order (165 units) via primary vendor
pros: Fast 1-day lead time ensures rapid replenishment
High on-time reliability (90.0%)
Single consolidated invoice and delivery point
cons: Higher unit price than secondary farm-direct sources
Single point of operational dependency

pros: Lowest blended unit cost (₹891.36/unit)

Eliminates vendor lock-in & single-point failure risk
cons: Two deliveries and invoices to receive and reconcile
scenarios.ai_recommendation_reason: Maximizes financial savings (₹12975.60) while securing an immediate 66 units buffer within 1 days.

scenarios.name: Scenario C: Delay Purchase (Just-In-Time)
scenarios.strategy: Postpone order by 3 days and place smaller order for 132 units
pros: Preserves immediate working capital for 72 hours
cons: Severe risk (85%+) of stockout during peak service hours
Zero safety inventory buffer against demand spikes

scenarios.name: Scenario D: Cheapest Supplier (Malnad Coffee Planters Direct)
scenarios.strategy: Full order (165 units) via lowest-cost vendor
pros: Maximum unit cost savings (₹864.80/unit)
Savings of ₹17358.00 vs baseline quote
cons: Longer lead time (4 days) may not cover stockout window
Single supplier concentration risk

scenarios.name: Scenario E: Reliability-First (Malnad Coffee Planters Direct)
scenarios.strategy: Full order (165 units) via most reliable vendor
pros: Highest supplier reliability (94.5%)
Strong on-time delivery rate (92.0%)
Minimizes fulfillment uncertainty
cons: May not be cheapest option
Single supplier dependency

scenarios.name: Scenario F: Emergency Expedited (Crisis Response)
scenarios.strategy: Rush 82 units via fastest vendor with expedite surcharge

Prevents immediate stockout crisis
Buys time for larger follow-up order
cons: 15% expedite surcharge (₹1070.88/unit)
Only covers 82 units — follow-up order needed
Highest cost per unit of all scenarios
